title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated Plant MagAttract v.3
author: Graeme Oatley

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer master mix with the following volumes per sample:

substeps.instruction: 200 µL Phosphate buffered saline (PBS)
20 µL Proteinase K
4 µL RNase A
150 µL Buffer AL

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Lysis
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 mg of cryogenically homogenised tissue from each sample to 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes and place on dry ice to keep frozen.

steps.title: Lyse Samples
steps.instruction: Add 374 µL of the lysis buffer master mix to each sample and homogenise by gently pipetting 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip. Incubate on a heat block at 55 °C at 600 rpm for 1 hour.

substeps.instruction: Set heat block to 55 °C
Centrifuge tubes briefly to collect liquid before incubation
Centrifuge tubes briefly to spin down after incubation

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Plates for DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Label nine 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates and fill the required wells as follows:

substeps.instruction: Tip plate: 96-well tip comb (no reagent)
Elution 2: 200 µL Buffer AE
Elution 1: 200 µL Buffer AE
NFW Wash: 500 µL Nuclease-Free Water
PE Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer PE
PE Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer PE
MW1 Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer MW1
MW1 Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer MW1
Sample plate: 15 µL Suspension G magnetic beads and 280 µL Buffer MB

steps.title: Load Samples and Run DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer lysate from sample tubes to individual wells in the sample plate using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 380 µL, avoiding large pieces of debris.

substeps.instruction: Select the DNA extraction protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex and press play
Load filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions
Remove the Tip Plate when prompted before loading the Sample Plate
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 50 minutes) and remove plates upon completion

steps.title: Clean Eluates and Combine
steps.instruction: Inspect elution plates for magnetic beads. If beads are present, transfer samples to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, place on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes, and collect the clear eluate with a wide-bore tip.

substeps.instruction: Use a 200 µL multi-channel pipette and wide-bore tips to pipette eluates from Elution Plate 2 into Elution Plate 1
Gently pipette mix 5–10 times with wide-bore tips to homogenise DNA

steps.title: Prepare Plates for 0.45X SPRI
steps.instruction: Set up KingFisher plates for the 0.45X SPRI as follows:

substeps.instruction: Tip Plate (1 mL deep-well): 96-well tip comb (no reagent)
Sample Plate (Elution Plate 1 from previous step, 1 mL deep-well): 380 µL DNA + 171 µL AMPure PB beads
Ethanol Wash Plate (1 mL deep-well): 1000 µL 80% EtOH (freshly made)
Elution Plate (200 µL standard): 135 µL Buffer EB

steps.title: Run 0.45X SPRI Protocol
steps.instruction: Select the 0.45X SPRI protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex and press play.

substeps.instruction: Load filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 40 minutes) and remove plates upon completion

steps.title: Final Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Transfer 130 µL of eluate from the elution plate into microcentrifuge tubes using a wide-bore pipette tip.

substeps.instruction: Incubate DNA at room temperature overnight
Perform QC the following morning
Store DNA at 4 °C
